hub.subtitle: Import workouts from your COROS watch

status.comingSoon: Coming soon: workouts from your COROS watch will go into your burn numbers automatically.
status.idle: Workouts from your COROS watch go into your burn numbers automatically.
status.connectHint: Connect your COROS account to import your watch workouts automatically.
status.lastFailed: The last sync failed. Try syncing again.

callback.title: COROS is not connected
callback.noCode: COROS did not send an authorization code. Try connecting again from the Profile page.

notes.text: JoyoRogo reads your COROS watch workouts through COROS's official MCP server: type, time, duration and calories. Data is read only when you press Sync or open Profile.
notes.dedupe: The same workout from Health Connect, Apple Health or Strava is not counted twice. Disconnect removes the connection and every workout imported from COROS.

error.noCode: COROS did not return an authorization code.

server.notConfigured: COROS is not configured on the server.
server.rejected: The COROS connection was refused. Reconnect from the profile page.
server.badState: This COROS connection request is not valid or has expired. Start again from the profile page.
server.retry: Couldn't reach COROS. Try again later.
server.connectFirst: Connect COROS first on the profile page.
server.expired: The COROS connection has expired. Reconnect from the profile page.
